scope: Exploratory general pure-two-row-component square-removal question under arbitrary matching and exterior. Later mixed-color family and guard ownership results not supplied in this first turn.
assessment: Supplies a general constructive proof: pure two-row endpoint components reduce to at most one matching edge without single terminality. Block decomposition, first-zero guard switch, horizontal/vertical cases and sharp three-column example independently checked before adoption. Not a review of later implementations or the separate mixed-family classification.
